newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki expects fire damage to total Y1.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki expects fire damage to total Y1.5 bln.

text.p: Aisin Seiki Co Ltd said on Monday that a fire at one of its factories at the weekend is likely to have caused 1.5 billion yen worth of damage to the facility.
The fire completely destroyed the factory, one of Aisin's 13 plants supplying vehicle parts to Toyota Motor Corp.
An Aisin spokesman said the firm would be unable to supply some brake-related products to Toyota as it had not found an alternative production facility.
About 90 percent of the company's products are shipped to Toyota, the spokesman said.
The spokesman also said that Aisin had not been able to assess the impact of the fire on its earnings.
